chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salama ibn al-Khattab, from al-Hasan ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, concerning His saying:
Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “And when Our clear verses are recited to them, those who disbelieve say to those who believe: which of the two groups is better in station and finer in assembly?”

He عليه السلام said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله called Quraysh to our wilayah, but they recoiled and denied. So those of Quraysh who disbelieved said to those who believed—those who affirmed Amir al-Mu'minin and us, the Ahl al-Bayt—“Which of the two groups is better in station and finer in assembly?” as a taunt from them. Then Allah replied to them: “And how many a generation from the former nations have We destroyed before them, who were better in furnishings and outward appearance?”
I said: His saying, “Whoever is in misguidance, let the All-Merciful prolong for him a prolonging.”

He عليه السلام said: All of them were in misguidance, not believing in the wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام nor in our wilayah. Thus they were astray and leading others astray, so He extends them in their misguidance and rebellion until they die, then Allah makes them in a worse place and weaker in force.
I said: His saying, “Until, when they see what they are promised—either the punishment or the Hour—then they will know who is worse in place and weaker in force.”

He عليه السلام said: As for His saying, “Until, when they see what they are promised,” it is the خروج of al-Qa'im, and it is the Hour. Then on that day they shall know, and know what comes down upon them from Allah at the hands of His Qa'im. That is His saying, “who is worse in place,” meaning in the presence of al-Qa'im, “and weaker in force.”
I said: His saying, “And Allah increases those who are guided in guidance.”
He عليه السلام said: On that day He increases them in guidance upon guidance through their following al-Qa'im, when they neither reject him nor deny him.
I said: His saying, “They do not possess intercession except one who has taken a covenant with the All-Merciful.”
He عليه السلام said: Except the one who professed religion to Allah through the wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin and the Imams after him; that is the covenant with Allah.
I said: His saying, “Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds—the All-Merciful will appoint for them affection.”
He عليه السلام said: The wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin is the affection that Allah, Exalted is He, spoke of.
I said: “So We have only made it easy in your tongue, that you may give glad tidings by it to the people of taqwa and warn by it a contentious people.”

He عليه السلام said: Allah only made it easy upon his tongue when he established Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام as a banner, so he gave glad tidings thereby to the believers and warned thereby the disbelievers; and they are those whom Allah mentioned in His Book as contentious, meaning disbelievers.

He said: And I asked him about the saying of Allah, “That you may warn a people whose fathers were warned, yet they are heedless.” He عليه السلام said: That you may warn the people among whom you are, just as their fathers were warned, while they are heedless of Allah, of His Messenger, and of His warning.

“The word has indeed become binding upon most of them,” among those who do not affirm the wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام and the Imams after him. So they do not believe in the Imamate of Amir al-Mu'minin and the successors after him. When they did not affirm, their punishment became what Allah mentioned: “Indeed We have placed shackles on their necks, so they reach to the chins, and they are with heads raised,” in the Fire of Hell.

Then he said: “And We have placed before them a barrier and behind them a barrier, then We covered them, so they do not see,” as a punishment from Him for them when they denied the wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام and the Imams after him. This is in the world, and in the Hereafter they are in the Fire of Hell with heads raised.

Then he said: “O Muhammad, it is all the same to them whether you warn them or do not warn them; they will not believe” in Allah and in the wilayah of Ali and those after him. Then he said: “You only warn the one who follows the Reminder,” meaning Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام, “and fears the All-Merciful in the unseen; so give him glad tidings, O Muhammad, of forgiveness and a noble reward.”

key_terms.إِمَامَةِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the divinely designated Imamate of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام
key_terms.الْقَائِمِ: the rising Imam from the Ahl al-Bayt who manifests divine justice
key_terms.الْوُدُّ: affection or loving acceptance granted by Allah
key_terms.عَهْدًا: a covenant taken with Allah through true allegiance
key_terms.مُقْمَحُونَ: with heads raised and constrained, describing a state of punishment
key_terms.وَلَايَةِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the authority and guardianship of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام
key_terms.وَلَايَتِنَا: our divinely ordained authority and guardianship

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret Qur'anic verses about guidance, intercession, and punishment through the doctrine of wilayah?
ai.summary: This narration presents a tafsir in which several Qur'anic verses are interpreted in relation to the wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin عليٌّ عليه السلام and the Imams after him. It contrasts the fate of those who deny this covenant with those who accept divine guidance, linking wilayah, shafa'ah, guidance, warning, and the events associated with al-Qa'im عليه السلام.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Al Hassan Bin Abdul Rahman, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [19:73] And when Our clear Verses are recited to them, those who disbelieve say to those who believe: Which of the two sects is better in position and best in assembly? Heasws said: ‘It was so that Rasool-Allahsaww called the Qureysh to ourasws Wilayah, but they fled and denied. So those who disbelieved from the Qureysh said to those who believed from the Qureysh, ‘Are you acknowledging to Amir Al-Momineenasws and for us there are family members, Which of the two sects is better in position and best in assembly? In order to humiliate from them. So Allahazwj Rebutted upon them 19:74] And how many of the generations have We Destroyed before them who were better in respect of equipment and outwardly appearance!’. I said, ‘Hisazwj Words [19:75] Say: As for him who was in error, the Beneficent would Prolong his term’. Heasws said: ‘All of them used to be in the straying, not believing in the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineenasws nor in ourasws Wilayah. Thus, they were straying, and leading (others) astray. So Heazwj Extended for them in their straying and their rebellion until they died, so Allahazwj Caused them to come to an evil place and weakest army’. I said, ‘Hisazwj Words [19:75] until they see what they were threatened with, either the Punishment or the Hour; So they shall soon be knowing who was in an evil position and a weaker army’. Heasws said: ‘As for Hisazwj Words until they see what they were threatened with, so that is the coming out of Al-Qaimasws, and it is the Hour, So they shall soon be knowing that day and what descends with them from Allahazwj upon the hands of Hisazwj Qaimasws. Thus, these are Hisazwj Words who was in an evil position, Meaning in the presence of Al-Qaimasws, and and a weaker army’. I said, ‘Hisazwj Words [19:76] And Allah would Increase in Guidance those who (seek) Guidance. Heasws said: ‘Heazwj would Increase them on that day, Guidance upon Guidance, due to their following Al-Qaimasws, when they will neither be rejecting himasws nor denying himasws’. I said, ‘Hisazwj Words [19:87] They shall not have control over intercession, except he who took a Covenant with the Beneficent. Heasws said: ‘Except the one who made it a Religion of allahazwj by the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineenasws and the Imamsasws from after himasws, so it is the Covenant with Allahazwj’. I said, ‘Hisazwj Words [19:96] (As for) those who believe and do righteous deeds, the Beneficent would Make the cordiality for them’. Heasws said: ‘Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineenasws, it is the cordiality which Allahazwj the Exalted Speaks of’. I said, ‘[19:97] So We have Made it easy by your tongue that you may give good news thereby to the pious and warn thereby a contentious people’. Heasws said: ‘But rather, Allahazwj Made it to be easy upon hissaww tongue when hesaww established Amir Al-Momineenasws as a flag, so the Momineen were given glad tidings by it and the disbelievers were warned by it, and they are those whom Allahazwj Mentioned in Hisazwj Book as ‘contentious’, i.e., disbelievers’.  He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked himasws about the Words [36:6] That you may warn a people (with) what their fathers were warned about, so they are heedless. Heasws said: ‘In order to warn the people whom yousaww are among just as their fathers were warned, but they were heedless from Allahazwj, and from Hisazwj Rasoolsaww, and from Hisazwj Threats. [36:7] The Word has proved to be True for most of them from the ones who are not acknowledging with the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineenasws and the Imamsasws from after himasws. Thus, they do not believe in the Imamate of Amir Al-Momineenasws and the successorsasws from after himasws. So when they were not acknowledging, their consequential Punishment was what Allahazwj Mentioned [36:8] Surely, We have placed chains on their necks, and these reach up to their chins, so they have their heads raised aloft in the Fire of Hell. Then Heazwj Said 36:9] And We have made in front of them a barrier and a barrier behind them, so We have Covered them over, so they are not seeing the consequential Punishment for them when they denied the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineenasws and the Imamsasws from after himasws. This is in the world, and in the Hereafter it is the Fire of Hell with their heads raised aloft. Then Heazwj Said: “O Muhammadsaww! [36:10] And it is alike to them whether you warn them or do not warn them, they will not be believing in the Wilayah of Aliasws and the onesasws from after himasws. Then Heazwj Said [36:11] But rather, You can only warn him who follows the Reminder Meaning Amir Al-Momineenasws, and fears the Beneficent in secret; so announce to him O Muhammadsaww, the good news of Forgiveness and an honourable Recompense’.
